blocks.text: Allaah's Name As-Saadiq The Truthful is found in one aayah of Allaah's Book and it is His saying,

And unto those who are Jews, We forbade every (animal) with undivided hoof, and We forbade them the fat of the ox and the sheep except what adheres to their backs or their entrails, or is mixed up with a bone. Thus We recompensed them for their rebellion [committing crimes like murdering the Prophets, eating of Riba (usury), etc.]. And verily, We are Truthful.
This means the Truthful in His promise and His threat and in everything that He informs us about. He fulfilled what He promised His servants of victory and establishment on the earth.
Then We fulfilled to them the promise, and We saved them and those whom We willed.

Allah has promised those among you who believe, and do righteous good deeds, that He will certainly grant them succession to (the present rulers) in the earth, as He granted it to those before them, and that He will grant them the authority to practise their religion, that which He has chosen for them (i.e. Islam). And He will surely give them in exchange a safe security after their fear (provided) they (believers) worship Me and do not associate anything (in worship) with Me. But whoever disbelieved after this, they are the Fasiqun (rebellious, disobedient to Allah).
He fulfilled what He promised His servants of a great victory and entrance into blessed gardens. Allaah said,

And they will say: "All the praises and thanks be to Allah Who has fulfilled His Promise to us and has made us inherit (this) land. We can dwell in Paradise where we will; how excellent a reward for the (pious good) workers!"
He is the Truthful One who does not break His promise. Allaah said,
Allah's Promise is the Truth, and whose words can be truer than those of Allah? (Of course, none).

From the effects of belief in this Name is that a good-doer does not fear being given too little or overburdened by oppression. He neither fears losing the weight of a speck of dust because Allaah has promised – and He is The Truthful – to give those who do good deeds their rewards. Even if it be the weight of a speck of dust He will reward it and not let it go to waste. Indeed He multiplies it for whomever He wills and He gives a tremendous reward from Himself.
As for the evil doer, He recompenses his evil deed with the like of it and He removes it from him after repentance, regret, seeking forgiveness, good deeds and calamities. Allaah said,
They are those from whom We shall accept the best of their deeds and overlook their evil deeds. (They shall be) among the dwellers of Paradise, a promise of truth, which they have been promised.

keyPoints: The Name As-Saadiq is found in one aayah of Allaah's Book, An'aam 6:146.
It means the Truthful in His promise and His threat and in everything He informs us about.
He fulfilled what He promised His servants of victory and establishment on the earth, and of entrance into blessed gardens.
From the effects of belief in this Name: the good-doer does not fear oppression or losing even the weight of a speck of dust of reward.
The evil doer is recompensed with the like of his evil deed, and it is removed from him after repentance, regret, seeking forgiveness, good deeds and calamities.

evidence.text: Thus We recompensed them for their rebellion. And verily, We are Truthful.
Allah's Promise is the Truth, and whose words can be truer than those of Allah? (Of course, none).

recall.a: The Truthful in His promise and His threat and in everything that He informs us about.

recall.q: In which aayah is the Name As-Saadiq found?
recall.a: An'aam 6:146, ending 'And verily, We are Truthful.'

recall.q: What is an effect of belief in this Name for the good-doer?
recall.a: He does not fear being given too little or oppressed, nor losing even the weight of a speck of dust, because the Truthful has promised to reward good deeds.

recall.q: Through what is an evil deed removed from the evil doer?
recall.a: Through repentance, regret, seeking forgiveness, good deeds and calamities.
